01 — FIND YOUR FEETYou don’t need 27 tabs open.

Different jobs.
Different kinds of money.

Start with what the money is for. Then meet the options.

↙FOR THE UNEXPECTED

Your safety net

Money you can reach when life happens. Build this before taking market risk.

Savings account
The honest trade-off +

Easy access, usually lower growth. Inflation can reduce its buying power. Set a buffer based on your essential expenses.

≈FOR NEARER GOALS

Your steady ground

More predictability for money you’ll need sooner. Fewer surprises.

Fixed deposits & bonds
The honest trade-off +

FDs have a stated term and early withdrawal may cost you. Bonds carry issuer risk and can lose value if sold early. Rates, fees and access vary.

↗FOR THE LONG RUN

Your growth engine

A small piece of many companies. Time to grow, and room for bad years.

Broad-market index funds
The honest trade-off +

Values can fall sharply; returns aren’t guaranteed. Fund costs and exit terms vary. A SIP simply means investing regularly — it isn’t a separate investment.

And gold, individual stocks and everything else? ↗

Gold has price swings and no guaranteed income. Individual stocks concentrate risk in fewer companies. More choices don’t automatically make a better plan. Understand each product’s costs, risks and access before adding it.
